question: A right square pyramid has base side 24 cm and slant height 20 cm. Find its volume.
solution:
**Given:**

Base side of the square pyramid = 24 cm

Slant height = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a square pyramid = (1/3) × (Base Area) × Height

Base Area = side²

Height = √(slant height² − (side/2)²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Base Area = 24² = 576 cm²

⇒ Height = √(20² − (24/2)²)

⇒ Height = √(400 − 144)

⇒ Height = √256 = 16 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 576 × 16

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 9216

⇒ Volume = 3072 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3072.**
